fable.w: This section only rescinds previously appropriated funds. There is no tempting reading here: it mentions no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision.
fable.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–317, $2,250,000 are rescinded.

opus.w: This section only rescinds $2,250,000 of earlier appropriations. It does not provide for any consultation, comment period, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue. No outside party takes part in a federal decision, so there is nothing that could count as participation.
opus.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–317, $2,250,000 are rescinded.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a simple appropriation rescission. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public comment periods, or requirements to consult with states, tribes, or the public mentioned in the text.
qwen_chat.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–317, $2,250,000 are rescinded.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that rescinding funds is a "decision" and therefore any process leading to it involves participation. However, the text itself contains no mention of any process, consultation, hearing, or interaction with outside parties. It is a unilateral legislative action regarding budget numbers.
